style: who is speaking to whom, and what has just happened

candidates.angle: yogis recover past understanding without effort
candidates.evidence: बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम् (he attains the union with discernment from his previous body)

candidates.angle: he strives again with greater force
candidates.evidence: यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ (and then he strives again toward complete success)

candidates.angle: Arjuna fears a failed effort is wasted
candidates.evidence: अर्जुन को डर था कि योगभ्रष्ट का प्रयास शून्य हो जाएगा

angle_en: The yogi regains past discernment effortlessly
angle_hi: योगी को पूर्वजन्म की समझ अनायास ही मिल जाती है

en.intro: Arjuna has just asked if a failed yogi is lost forever. Krishna answers by describing what happens in the next life. Listen for the two stages of recovery.
en.notice: Krishna says the yogi regains the buddhisanyoga, the spiritual understanding from his former body, effortlessly. Then he strives again with greater force toward complete success.
en.next: Even against his will, he is drawn onward by that earlier practice.
en.meaning: O son of Kuru, there he effortlessly regains the spiritual understanding from his previous life. Then he strives again, with greater force, toward complete success.

hi.intro: अर्जुन ने पूछा था कि योगभ्रष्ट का प्रयास क्या शून्य हो जाता है। श्रीकृष्ण बताते हैं कि अगले जन्म में क्या होता है, ध्यान से सुनिए।
hi.meaning: हे कुरुनन्दन, वहाँ पर उसे पूर्वजन्म की बुद्धिसंयोग (साधना की समझ) अनायास ही प्राप्त हो जाती है। फिर वह संसिद्धौ (पूर्ण सफलता की ओर) भूयः (फिर से) अधिक बल से यत्न करता है।
hi.notice: यहाँ बुद्धिसंयोग शब्द पर ध्यान दीजिए, जो पूर्वदेहिकम् है, यानी पिछले शरीर से जुड़ी समझ। उसे अनायास ही मिल जाती है। फिर वह संसिद्धौ की ओर भूयः, यानी फिर से, अधिक बल से यत्न करता है।
hi.next: वह पूर्व अभ्यास के कारण अपनी इच्छा के बिना भी आगे खिंचा चला जाता है।

en.intro: Arjuna has just asked if a failed yogi is lost forever. Krishna answers by describing what happens in the next life. Listen for the two stages of recovery.
en.body: O son of Kuru, there he effortlessly regains the spiritual understanding from his previous life. Then he strives again, with greater force, toward complete success. Krishna says the yogi regains the buddhisanyoga, the spiritual understanding from his former body, effortlessly. Then he strives again with greater force toward complete success. Even against his will, he is drawn onward by that earlier practice.
